title: Interview. Billionaire Square (Block) Cofounder Jim McKelvey on Competing Against Amazon

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this exceptional interview, we talk to Cofounder of Square (Block) Jim McKelvey on competing against Amazon.
reader_summary.overview: In this exceptional interview, we talk to Cofounder of Square (Block) Jim McKelvey on competing against Amazon. From his time at Square, he saw how they were able to outcompete Amazon and he wasn't sure how that was possible given their superior resources. After better understanding how that was possible, he wrote a book on his insights called "The Innovation Stack".

key_points.text: In this interview we touch on some of his key learnings.
